row.evidence: Monte Carlo's pricing page lists "Advanced Security: SSO, SCIM, Self-Hosted Storage, PII Filtering, Audit Logging" on the Scale tier, not on the entry Start tier (up to 10 users); all tiers are "Request pricing".
row.notes: Credit-based pricing with no public prices ("Request pricing"); tiers are Start (up to 10 users), Scale, Enterprise and Business Critical. SSO (SAML 2.0) and SCIM both start at Scale, one tier above Start, so SCIM is gated above the team plan. SCIM docs name Okta and Microsoft Entra ID as the supported IdPs, both set up as custom apps with the account's SCIM v2 endpoint URL and bearer token; SSO is not required for SCIM. Only email/userName, active, givenName and familyName are read; other attributes are ignored. The GraphQL API (users, invites, authorization groups, roles, audit logs) is on every tier with daily call caps of 10,000 (Start), 50,000 (Scale) and 100,000 (Enterprise).

auth.token_source: Settings -> Users -> SCIM -> Add (Account Owner); endpoint URL and bearer token shown after Continue

operations.notes: PUT vs PATCH is not documented. Okta Deactivate Users and Entra Delete actions are both recommended; docs say Monte Carlo will 'create, update or destroy users and groups' on receipt.

deprovision.notes: Docs say SCIM removes users who no longer have access in the IdP; whether the user record is soft-disabled or hard-deleted is not spelled out.

custom.how: Docs say all other attributes are ignored.

roles.how: Groups pushed by the IdP become authorization groups that get the Default Role chosen at SCIM setup; roles are then edited per group in Monte Carlo.

limitations.text: Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are listed as supported SCIM IdPs.
Okta Sync Password is not supported.
userName must be mapped to the user's email; user uniqueness is by email and group matching is by authorization group name.

auth.notes: API keys via x-mcd-id / x-mcd-token headers, or OAuth 2.0 client credentials (personal or service clients) returning a short-lived JWT bearer token.

endpoints.purpose: List users in the account, filterable by authorization group and email
Update a user's authorization group membership
Create or update a customer-managed authorization group
List roles available in the account
Create or update a custom role
Get audit logs for an account

audit_log_api.notes: getAccountAuditLogs GraphQL query; data may lag up to 10 hours. Pricing lists Audit Logging under Scale.

rate_limits.text: Daily API call caps by tier: 10,000 (Start), 50,000 (Scale), 100,000 (Enterprise and Business Critical).

limitations.text: Changing a user's group membership expires their existing API keys.

okta.notes: No OIN app; Monte Carlo documents a custom Okta app integration with SCIM enabled against its generic endpoint.

entra.notes: Monte Carlo documents a custom (non-gallery) Entra enterprise application for SSO and SCIM; Entra gallery listing not checked beyond the vendor doc.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin per Monte Carlo's SSO doc; Google is not a supported SCIM IdP.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin 'SAML Custom Connector (Advanced)' per Monte Carlo's SSO doc.
